preservation is ongoing, and digital objects will still require careful stewardship into the future. But once content has been liberated from deteriorating disks, the recovered files and disk images can continue to be

as our technology changes.

Major galleries, libraries, archives and museums have been working for years to build and preserve digital archives. But much historically significant content remains with individuals and smaller organisations, outside of

digital preservation ecosystems.

Into the Victorian archives

.

names like Greaseweazle and Applesauce.

If we don’t save this content, it will not be available for future use.
There were genealogical files, Word documents, oral history materials, sporting club records and photographs of large engineering projects.
